turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: Your resume is impressive, but tell me, what is the single most valuable skill you bring to this specific team?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My most valuable skill is turning messy projects into plans people can actually follow. Because when a team is lost, someone has to say, okay, here's what we do on Monday. For example, last semester our capstone was three weeks behind, so I set up weekly check-ins and a shared board, and we shipped on time and got an A. So, um, organizing chaos, that's what I'd bring to your team.
